qa: The effects trigger simultaneously, so the player can choose the activation order.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] If [Gallantmon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon gets +4000 DP and 1 of their Digimon gets -4000 DP. [When Digivolving] [End of Attack] [Once per Turn] Delete 1 of your opponent's 10000 DP or lower Digimon. If this effect didn't delete, trash their top security card and this Digimon unsuspends. [All Turns] While you have 0 or less memory, this Digimon isn't affected by your opponent's Digimon's effects.
